synthesis_provenance.first_pass_synthesis_verbatim:
I’m researching AI agents, and the tricky bit is… they’re not just chatbots with a fancy hat.

A language model can answer a question. An agent can keep going: make a decision, choose a tool, read a document, search for information, maybe do several steps in a row.

So I’m staring at my old workshop-agent notes, wondering where the line is.

Because once an AI can actually *do* things—not just tell me it could do things—stuff gets interesting fast.

It can also get things wrong fast.

An agent can sound very confident while heading directly toward a terrible idea. So every “great plan” still needs checking.

I think the smallest useful test is this: give one agent a job, a little information, and one tool.

Then watch what it chooses to do.

Well… now I want to try it.

accepted_script:
I found the old workshop-agent notes again, and I’m realizing I may have accidentally given a tiny project a much bigger job than it deserved.

An AI agent isn’t just a chatbot that says clever things. It can make decisions, choose tools, look up information, read documents, write things down, call other software, and keep track of what happened before.

Which sounds useful.

It also sounds like the beginning of a very organized disaster.

The interesting part is not whether we can slap the word “agent” on a box. The interesting part is: can it actually do something? Can it handle a job with more than one step without wandering off, forgetting the point, or confidently inventing nonsense?

Because AI can sound extremely sure while being completely wrong. That is not wisdom. That is a very confident toaster.

And then there’s the weird version: more than one agent in the same environment. They might share information, split jobs, disagree, or make plans together. That does not mean they’re secretly alive. It means I have a lot more questions now.

So I’m going to figure out the smallest real test: give an agent a goal, some tools, and enough memory to see whether it stays useful.

What should I make it try first?
